page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.6xlarge is a high clock speed, memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a dedicated 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The system provides 24 vCPUs derived from 12 physical cores with 2 threads per core. Cache configuration includes 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 33 MB L3 cache pool. The processor supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512 (including AVX512F, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16), AES cryptographic acceleration, and FMA.

The instance delivers a substantial memory footprint of 192.0 GB RAM, reflecting an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio that aligns with memory-intensive compute environments. Benchmark testing shows memory read speeds of 86.33 GB/sec and write speeds of 50.31 GB/sec on large 256MB uncached blocks, along with 1398.59 GB/sec on small cached 16KB blocks. Networking capabilities include an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. The instance features zero bundled local storage, requiring network-attached storage options, and contains no hardware GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks across standard test suites indicate solid mid-tier execution. In CPU benchmarking, the instance achieved a multi-core stress-ng rating of 24,990.45 and a single-core score of 1,579.68, while Geekbench recorded 10,175.0 multi-core and 1,334.0 single-core metrics. PassMark testing returned an overall CPU score of 25,234.51 with an extended instruction test score of 22,426.52. Workload-specific results registered static web serving throughput at 18.05 GB/sec and Redis SET performance at 23.38 million operations per second, supported by multi-threaded bzip3 decompression at 110.11 GB/sec.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, the ecs.hfr7.6xlarge combines high sustained CPU frequency with high memory density. The absence of local disk drives requires external block storage dependencies, but its large RAM footprint and solid instruction set capabilities offer strong consolidation efficiency for in-memory databases, large caching layers, compilation tasks, and intensive enterprise application backends.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.6xlarge is a memory-oriented high-frequency compute instance built on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running on KVM, it features 24 dedicated vCPUs (12 physical cores) and a large 192.0 GB memory capacity (8.0 GB per vCPU). The instance lacks integrated local storage and GPU accelerators, relying on network-attached volumes and an 8 Gbps network baseline. Hardware acceleration supports AVX-512 extensions including VNNI and BF16 alongside AES cryptography. Synthetic benchmarks demonstrate balanced mid-range multi-core performance, yielding a PassMark CPU score of 25,234.51 and 23.38 million Redis SET operations per second. With large uncached read throughput of 86.33 GB/sec and robust decompression capabilities, this server profile is well-matched for in-memory caching, distributed database nodes, Clang software builds, and high-frequency enterprise computing.
